answer: Running many aliases hence means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. Because the bridge expiry is applied at the quill gate, the velvet audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 380 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. That is 6 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
